page_title: AST 3-1 LUT | Aston Villa v Luton 29/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, John Brooks has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' The ball goes out of play. Luton are awarded a corner kick.
90+3' Andros Townsend (Luton) takes the corner.
90+3' Elijah Adebayo (Luton) has a crack at goal from inside the box, but the defender somehow makes the block to deny him. The linesman makes the right call and Luton will have a corner.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' Unai Emery has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Leander Dendoncker (Aston Villa) replacing Douglas Luiz.
90' That will be all from Moussa Diaby who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Bertrand Traore (Aston Villa).
88' John Brooks couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) and blew his whistle.
86' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and John Brooks blows for a foul.
84' Elijah Adebayo (Luton) is caught offside!
83' 3 - 1 Emiliano Martinez (Aston Villa) scores an unfortunate own goal after deflecting the ball into his own net!
81' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
80' John McGinn (Aston Villa) gets inside the box and tries to beat Thomas Kaminski with a measured shot into the bottom left corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
79' Unai Emery has decided to substitute Matty Cash and he is replaced by Diego Carlos (Aston Villa).
79' The manager makes a subsitution with Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) coming on for Boubacar Kamara.
79' That's the end of the game for Alfie Doughty, who is replaced by Ryan Giles (Luton).
76' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles past the left post.
76' Rob Edwards has decided to make a change. Elijah Adebayo (Luton) replaces Carlton Morris.
76' It will be a substitution. Pelly-Ruddock Mpanzu (Luton) is ready to enter the pitch as Marvelous Nakamba walks off.
75' Alfie Doughty (Luton) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
73' Ross Barkley (Luton) pulls the trigger and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but his effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
73' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) is able to continue to play.
72' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
71' John Brooks shows a yellow card to Boubacar Kamara (Aston Villa) for his blatant foul.
68' Tahith Chong (Luton) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
68' Luton have been awarded a corner kick.
66' Carlton Morris (Luton) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when John Brooks blows for a foul.
62' 3 - 0 Tom Lockyer (Luton) puts the ball into the back of the net but, unfortunately for him and his teammates, it's into his own goal!

61' Ross Barkley (Luton) tries his luck with a long-range shot from a rebound, but it isn't precise at all and the ball flies miles over the crossbar. Very poor shot. The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.
60' The referee points to the corner flag and Luton will take a corner.
60' Alfie Doughty (Luton) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Luton.
59' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Luton.
58' The linesman raises his flag. Tahith Chong (Luton) is adjudged offside.
58' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Tahith Chong (Luton) comes onto the pitch for Jacob Brown.
57' Here comes a substitution. Gabriel Osho is given a rest as he is replaced by Andros Townsend (Luton).

56' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Luton.
55' It will be a corner kick for Aston Villa.
55' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The linesman points to the corner flag, Aston Villa are going to take it.
53' Yellow card. Issa Kabore (Luton) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
51' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) has tested the patience of referee John Brooks and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
49' 2 - 0 What a hit! Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) shows good composure inside the box to fire a first-time shot into the bottom left corner. 2:0.
49' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Lucas Digne (Aston Villa), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
47' John McGinn (Aston Villa) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Thomas Kaminski, who smothers the ball.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Unai Emery gives a chance to Leon Bailey and Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) is off.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) was so close to scoring direct from the corner. His curled effort hit the post!
45+1' A cross from a corner kick by Aston Villa is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

45+1' Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Aston Villa force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) brings an opponent down and John Brooks interrupts the game. Luton have a free kick.
44' Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
43' Aston Villa couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Thomas Kaminski (Luton) leaped high and intercepted a cross.

42' Boubacar Kamara (Aston Villa) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee John Brooks saw the whole situation. Luton win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
40' Pau Torres (Aston Villa) produces a long-range volley, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way.
38' Ross Barkley (Luton) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
37' John Brooks blows his whistle for a foul after Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) hacks down one of his opponents. A free kick is awarded to Luton.
36' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
35' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. Aston Villa win a corner kick.
33' 10:0 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
31' Issa Kabore (Luton) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. That's a free kick to Aston Villa.
29' Flag goes up against Teden Mengi (Luton) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
28' Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) is booked after bringing down an opponent. John Brooks had an easy-decision to make.
28' Half-chance! Chiedozie Ogbene (Luton) plays a pass into the box, but Emiliano Martinez reacts well to snuff out the attack.
26' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 77:23.
24' Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders.

23' It looks like Boubacar Kamara (Aston Villa) saw red with that tackle. John Brooks won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Luton are given an advantage. They have a free kick.

21' Pau Torres (Aston Villa) timed his run perfectly to connect with the resulting corner kick, but his finish from around the penalty spot was rather poor as it went way over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Luton will have a goal kick.
21' Aston Villa force a corner. They send men into the box.
20' The ball goes out for a corner. Aston Villa can continue in their attacking effort.
20' Half-chance! Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) plays a pass into the box, but Thomas Kaminski reacts well to snuff out the attack. Corner kick. Aston Villa will have an opportunity.

17' 1 - 0 John McGinn (Aston Villa) perfectly latches on to a cross from the set piece, controls the ball with one touch and releases a great effort into the bottom left corner and past the goalkeeper!
16' John Brooks interrupts the game. One of the players from Luton won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Aston Villa will take a free kick near the side line.
12' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Luton was in an offside position.

12' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot low towards the middle of the goal. However, Thomas Kaminski anticipates the shot and makes an easy save.
10' A pass from Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) is intercepted by Thomas Kaminski and the move breaks down.
9' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Aston Villa comes to nothing.
9' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked. Now Aston Villa have a corner.
9' Aston Villa try to speed play up by taking a quick free kick.
7' Aston Villa are seeing far more of the ball now.

5' Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Luton will have a goal kick.
4' Luton are ruled offside.
3' John McGinn (Aston Villa) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Luton.
2' Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Luton will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be John Brooks.
